inventory_method: sorted unique git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -z; regular source files; no dataset content read
primary_rule: fastfill recursively, tests included; root has no project source at root outside fastfill. Metric modules explicitly delegated. Docs executable helpers inventoried separately. Vendored roots excluded. Gitignored data/artifact directories excluded.

definitions.fresh_full: All source lines displayed and reviewed in this session at recorded SHA; final hash revalidated.

definitions.reused_hash_validated: Prior manifest explicitly claimed full read and its SHA-256 equals current file. No fresh full-read claim.
definitions.unreviewed: Inventoried and hashed only; metadata/hash is not source review.

fingerprint_recipe: SHA256 of UTF-8 concatenation of sorted(path + NUL + lowercase SHA256(file bytes) + LF), for files[] only.

parent_final_validation.attribution: Parent receipt, not this auditor test execution

independent_validation.limits: No GPU training, server operations, real mesh inventory, Blender rendering, dataset scan, or API scoring executed by this auditor.

coverage_limits: All 142 primary production source files are covered by fresh full reads or exact-hash prior full-read evidence. No primary production partial, missing, or unreviewed files remain.
v2/evaluate.py was fully read at parent request; delegated metric numerical results were not recomputed.
Tests retain this auditor own statuses; external Sartre ledger is attributed separately and was not modified. Passing tests do not imply full source review.
Frozen/historical copies, ancillary scripts, and delegated metric sources remain separately classified. Same-byte comparison is not a fresh full read.
Excluded vendor internals and actual mesh/data assets were not fully read. No whole-repository 100% claim.
JSON configs and dependency declarations have a separate, explicitly partial inventory.
No statement test coverage percentage is inferred from source-reading coverage.
audit_status: complete: primary production full source review, fresh or exact-hash prior evidence; tests separately owned

external_test_review.agent_id_status: unknown to this auditor; no live agent status queried
external_test_review.note: Snapshot only; parent must obtain reviewer completion. Its input-manifest hash predates this ledger closeout; individual test file hashes checked separately.
